title: Event stream
what: The service's one event stream, GET /events: message and folder changes kept in the store for a day, at most 10,000, handed out live as server-sent events or as pages, in src/events.rs and src/announcements.rs.

title: Service plumbing
what: The service's settings in layers, its HTTP routes behind the bearer token with each route registered beside its answer, the SQLite store, health, the command's entry and the service itself, in src/http.rs, settings.rs, store.rs, health.rs, lib.rs and main.rs.

title: Wire members and client
what: The bodies and queries every route takes and answers in the common wire format, the service's own reading of a message, a draft and a rule, the ids it names them by, and its Rust client with one method per route, in src/wire.rs, mail.rs, members.rs, keys.rs and client.rs.
